steps.title: Amplify cox1 gene by PCR
steps.instruction: Prepare a 25 µl PCR mixture containing 5 µl template DNA, 2 µM of each cox1 primer (Table 1), 20 µM dNTPs (Thermo Fisher Scientific, Drecich, Germany), Dream™ Taq Green polymerase and its buffer (Thermo Fisher Scientific). Run the thermocycler: 95 °C for 5 min; 35 cycles of 94 °C for 1 min, 55 °C for 1 min, 72 °C for 2 min; final extension at 72 °C for 10 min.

steps.title: Perform first ITS1 PCR (outer primers)
steps.instruction: In a 25 µl reaction add Dream™ Taq Green polymerase and buffer, 1 ng µl⁻¹ DNA template, 2 µM each outer primer (ITS1‑OutF and ITS1‑OutR, Table 1). Thermocycle: 95 °C for 1 min; 30 cycles of 94 °C for 1 min, annealing at 54 °C for 30 s, extension at 72 °C for 30 s; final extension at 72 °C for 5 min.

steps.title: Dilute and run nested ITS1 PCR
steps.instruction: Dilute the first‑PCR product 80‑fold with nuclease‑free water. Use 1 µl of this dilution as template in a second 25 µl PCR containing Dream™ Taq Green polymerase/buffer and 2 µM each inner primer (ITS1‑InF and ITS1‑InR, Table 1). Run the same cycling program as the first ITS1 PCR, but set the annealing temperature to 60 °C for T. vivax or 54 °C for all other Trypanosoma species. For T. grayi, increase the MgCl₂ concentration of the buffer by adding 2 mM MgCl₂.

steps.title: Resolve PCR products on agarose gel
steps.instruction: Prepare a 1.5 % (or 2 % for higher resolution) agarose gel containing 0.5 µg ml⁻¹ SERVA DNA Stain G (SERVA, Heidelberg, Germany). Load the PCR products and run electrophoresis under standard conditions until adequate separation is achieved.

steps.title: Excise and purify DNA fragments
steps.instruction: Using a clean scalpel, carefully cut out the desired bands from the gel. Purify the DNA with the GeneJet Gel Extraction Kit (Thermo Fisher Scientific) following the manufacturer’s protocol.

steps.title: Quantify purified DNA
steps.instruction: Measure DNA concentration at 260 nm with a Nanodrop 1000 spectrophotometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific).

steps.title: Clone PCR product into vector
steps.instruction: Insert the purified fragment into either the PCR™2.1‑TOPO vector (Thermo Fisher Scientific) which has 3′‑T overhangs, or the pJET1.2/blunt vector using the CloneJET PCR Kit (Thermo Fisher Scientific), according to the respective manufacturers’ instructions.

steps.title: Screen colonies by colony PCR
steps.instruction: Perform colony PCR on transformants to identify those containing the insert.

steps.title: Grow positive colonies in LB‑ampicillin
steps.instruction: Inoculate confirmed colonies into LB medium supplemented with ampicillin (100 µg ml⁻¹) and incubate with shaking overnight at 37 °C.

steps.title: Harvest cells and isolate plasmid DNA
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the overnight cultures at 4 °C, 4500 × g for 15 min. Purify plasmid DNA using either the NucleoBond Xtra Midi Plus kit (Macherey‑Nagel, Düren, Germany) or the GeneJET Plasmid MiniPrep Kit (Thermo Fisher Scientific) following the manufacturers’ protocols.
